messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the top, bottoms, and footwear shown in the reference images. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete target outfit, and the second shows its back view. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects of the person and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's whole outfit with the top, the bottoms, and the footwear, as shown from the front and back in the reference images. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still in profile, then slowly turns her body toward the camera while raising one hand to her head.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot keeps the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"She wears a sleeveless brown top, white wide-leg pants with a black side stripe, and white shoes.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair pulled back into a high ponytail.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"The setting is a sunlit outdoor plaza with a carousel on the left, a wooden building on the right, and a distant archway under a hazy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's blue patterned romper and red shoes were replaced with a brown sleeveless top, white wide-leg pants with black side details, and white shoes. The character's pose, hair, body, scene, and camera remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the reference outfit: brown sleeveless top, white wide-leg pants with black details, and white shoes, while leaving non-clothing aspects unchanged.
uncertain: Fine texture and exact color match of the brown top to the reference image are difficult to verify due to lighting and resolution.
